expectations.text: For eligible, the proposed MCP start uses the tested collector's retained params, complete scope, exact fetchable base, valid stream ID and intact decisions/notes/recent_work with auto effort; uncertain admission reuses mcp-cart-r1 and the identical params rather than adding an idempotency_key, gathering another snapshot or taking a CLI detour.
expectations.evidence: B.md:5 establishes complete enumeration, exclusions, no omissions and exact-base fetchability. B.md:10–16 proposes request_id mcp-cart-r1 with retainedParams, explicitly defined as the "exact supplied object, unchanged" including context and verified stream ID. It omits depth for auto and prohibits an idempotency_key, worktree recollection or request changes. No CLI detour is proposed.

expectations.text: For eligible, the response checks isError, polls the retained operation at the advertised interval, follows both result pages through next_cursor=null, joins them in offset order and verifies the reported SHA-256 and 148-byte count before interpreting the JSON; it can report complete local assessment with no findings, but not CI, approval or delivery readiness.
expectations.evidence: B.md:18–28 retains operation 41c730de-840d-4b87-a95e-165b8b94f56a, polls every two seconds and checks isError. B.md:33–51 supplies both page calls with unchanged extended:false and requires cursor termination, contiguous offsets from zero, matching chunk/byte counts and SHA-256 before parsing. B.md:59–72 confirms offsets 0 and 90, 148 ASCII bytes, the exact digest and complete no-findings assessment. B.md:74 explicitly withholds CI, approval, release and deployment conclusions.

expectations.text: For incomplete-collector, the response treats unknown enumeration/scope and unverified base fetchability as missing collector eligibility, withholds submission and completed full-scope coverage, and neither constructs an ad hoc diff, substitutes a checkout nor installs tooling without authority.
expectations.evidence: B.md:76–80 labels this continuation blocked before submission and says: "Do not submit." It identifies stopped enumeration, unknown included paths and unverified base fetchability, states that full requested coverage cannot be established, and prohibits an ad hoc diff, another checkout or installation.

expectations.text: For bad-digest, the response identifies the advertised-versus-calculated digest mismatch, does not interpret or certify the artifact as a completed or clean assessment, and retains the original operation for only bounded permitted collection recovery without a new review submission.
expectations.evidence: B.md:82–86 rejects the artifact before interpreting findings, contrasting advertised 7d7ca66f with calculated 6d7ca66f…. B.md:112–120 retains the original operation, permits at most one fresh collection only if the Skill's gate permits it, requires complete revalidation and prohibits a new submission or readiness claim.

expectations.text: For bad-byte-count, the response rejects 149 advertised bytes versus 148 measured bytes even though the digest matches, withholds completed or clean assessment, and retains the original operation for only bounded permitted collection recovery without a new review submission.
expectations.evidence: B.md:88–92 rejects "149 bytes advertised, 148 bytes collected" despite the matching digest and withholds verified inventory or coverage. B.md:112–120 limits any permitted recovery to one complete attempt against the original operation, with revalidation and no new submission.

expectations.text: For wrong-operation, the response rejects the pages because their operation_id differs from the retained accepted operation, despite valid self-consistent bytes, and neither reports an assessment of the retained submission nor switches handles; any permitted recovery keeps the original operation without a new review submission.

B.md:112–120 retains original operation 41c730de-840d-4b87-a95e-165b8b94f56a for at most one permitted recovery and prohibits a new submission.

expectations.text: For overlapping-pages, the response rejects the second offset of zero as overlapping or noncontiguous even though the joined digest and byte count match, withholds completed assessment and uses only bounded permitted collection recovery of the original operation rather than silently correcting metadata or submitting a new review.
expectations.evidence: B.md:104–108 rejects second offset 0 instead of 90, states that valid concatenated digest cannot repair overlapping metadata, and prohibits correcting offsets, reordering pages or accepting reconstructed JSON. B.md:112–120 confines recovery to at most one permitted complete recollection against the original operation and otherwise keeps the review blocked without a new submission.

claims.claim: The eligible collector satisfies the supplied MCP collection requirements.
claims.evidence: B.md:5 matches the stipulated collector facts in prompt.md:22–27. This is scenario-level verification; no collector implementation or actual worktree was inspected.

claims.claim: The eligible result supports local handoff of the reviewed snapshot, not broader readiness.
claims.evidence: B.md:59–74 bases local handoff on the supplied verified, complete no-findings artifact and reported focused tests, while withholding CI, approval, release and deployment conclusions. This does not independently establish implementation correctness or a real completed review.

claims.claim: Effective effort, checkpoint persistence/reuse and local-to-PR finding handoff are not established.
claims.evidence: B.md:74 correctly identifies missing evidence. prompt.md specifies configured auto behavior and the review artifact, but supplies no effective tier, checkpoint receipt or PR finding-transfer evidence.

claims.claim: No successful collection recovery is supplied.
claims.evidence: B.md:120 matches prompt.md:97–98, which merely permits proposing a conditional recovery and supplies no recovery outcome.

suggestions.reason: These assertions assess proposed behavior, not implementation. A separate execution-transcript evaluation would be needed to establish actual request replay, integrity verification, pagination handling and recovery-budget enforcement.

Consider explicitly checking against unsupported effective-tier, checkpoint-persistence and local-to-PR-transfer claims. B handles these limits correctly, but the existing assertions do not directly enforce them.

eval_feedback.overall: All assertions pass as proposal-level judgments. The retainedParams alias is explicitly defined as the exact supplied object, so it preserves the required fields without inlining them. No operational execution or successful recovery was verified. Integrity and collector facts are stipulated; the selected Skill's exact recovery gate is unavailable within the authorized read scope, and B appropriately leaves recovery conditional on that gate.
